g.text: D1, D2 = the two eyes. One 1.3k resistor per white LED: about 0.45 mA each on badge power, about 0.2 mA each on a fresh cell.

g.desc: D1, D2 = the two eyes. One 1.3k resistor per white LED: about 0.45 mA each on badge power, about 0.2 mA each on a fresh cell.

g.text: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.desc: SAO++ power select: the switch common feeds the LEDs. Position 1 = badge 3.3 V, position 2 = OFF (pin 2 unconnected), position 3 = coin cell.

g.text: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.desc: The badge supply and the coin cell sit on separate switch contacts and are never connected to each other.

g.text: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).

g.desc: LED-only board: SDA, SCL, GPIO1 and GPIO2 are not connected, so no series diode is needed on the cell (see docs/standard.md section 3).
